title: Requalify write verification and Mint scheduling in scratch
objective: Run fixture/scratch-only end-to-end qualification for Press due normalization, explicit Day Setup gating, Mint block generation from configured allotment, Mint hard walls, shifted readback failure, exact readback success, and Trinoor classification. Assert no real Todoist/Calendar/Vault writes, no billed calls, no live POST, and no runtime restart.
method: verification-only — no source repaired, no build regenerated, no commit. Scratch walkthrough FEEDBACK-28-scratch.py (fixture-only: in-memory fakes FakeTodoist/FakeStore/ShiftingStore, pure functions, in-memory TestClient against tmp vaults) re-proves each FEEDBACK-23..27 contract; focused/full suites rerun with the exact evidence commands; live :8746 checked GET-only before and after.

evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-23_press_due: Scratch S1: raw UTC wall 23:00 != intent 19:00 (original failure); normalized 23:00Z through America/New_York == 19:00 local verifies clean; true mismatch fails with 12h '7 PM'/'11 PM' and NO raw 24h; missing timezone fails closed; structured detail keeps intent 18:00/live 19:00/live_raw 2026-07-12T23:00:00Z/live_timezone America/New_York/reason mismatch.
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-24_setup_gate: Scratch S2: /gather skeleton runstate NOT confirmed; /plan-inputs day_setup_confirmed False; /commit?mode=live 409 with ZERO vault bytes written (byte-for-byte before/after); /runtime-actions apply and undo both 409; only POST /day-setup confirms and unblocks a live commit (200 ok with FakeLiveTodoist/FakeLiveStore).
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-25_mint_capacity: Scratch S3: 300-min allotment -> aggregate Minting row 10 blocks/300 min; dated override same; hardcoded 2-block default survives ONLY without allotment context; capacity frame reserves mint 10; 10 selected sessions total 10 blocks (sessions win, no aggregate).
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-25_mint_walls: Scratch S4: assigned row overlapping selected Mint session hard-rejected (no overlap-grant escape); back-to-back touch allowed; Mint row itself exempt; /validate-sequence route rejects the same overlap shape.
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-26_mint_readback: Scratch S5: shifted 13:00-14:00 -> 13:30-14:30 readback FAILS with kind=calendar structured ISO mismatches; end-only drift records duration_min 60 vs 30; exact readback PASSES (empty verify); same-title source event never treated as our write (created e5001, noops empty).
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-26_trinoor_exact: Scratch S6: canonical '🟡 Trinoor : Morning' is Step D'; 'Trinoor sync' anchored block is Step E not D'; 'Trinoorish' is plain Step D.
evidence_chain_consistency.FEEDBACK-27_fixtures: Focused suites rerun exactly: backend test_feedback_write_mint.py 30 passed; frontend feedback_write_mint.test.ts 8 passed — matches FEEDBACK-27 evidence (30 backend / 8 frontend).
